label: Memorandum of understanding
event: Fincantieri and WSense sign a memorandum of understanding on strategic collaboration.
platform_read: Strategic Partner Map: Fincantieri flagged as likely largest customer and likely acquirer. Lesson candidate opened.

label: Strategic investor
event: Fincantieri formalises an investment in WSense through a convertible loan.
platform_read: Cap table: strategic now a shareholder. Commercial traction risk falls. Constraint moves to Operations and delivery.

label: Co-development
event: Technology and commercial co-development agreement (illustrative, source not found).
platform_read: Strategic path: co-development signed before exclusivity. Exit-readiness pack started.

label: Majority stake
event: Fincantieri agrees to take a majority stake in WSense, part of about €600m across four underwater deals.
platform_read: Exit. Lesson drafted from four sources and proposed for approval.
